people.text: Sandro wants to visit a factory where they'll organise something special for his birthday, and where he'll see everything that's involved in producing ice cream. His parents want to spend some time outdoors during their visit.
Jana's family would like to go to a factory that makes ice cream using traditional methods. Jana wants to try out different activities there, and make something that she can take home.
Kem wants to see a factory that cares about its effects on the environment, and would like to find out how new flavours are invented. His dad enjoys visiting historically interesting buildings.
Luisa would like to create her own ice cream using a variety of ingredients. Her mum wants to try other products the factory makes, and find something to entertain Luisa's small sister.
Matty would like to visit a factory that produces ice cream with unusual flavours, and buy a souvenir there. His mum wants to find out about the history of the company.

items.label: A
items.title: Frida's Farm
items.text: Offers DIY ice cream making with custom ingredients, an indoor playground for children, and serves home-made cakes. Perfect for birthday events, with outdoor seating areas.

items.label: B
items.title: Henry's
items.text: Uses 50-year-old traditional methods, located in a historic farmhouse with a focus on environmental sustainability. Visitors can meet the cows that produce the milk.

items.label: C
items.title: Denton's
items.text: Has made ice cream since 1900, with a museum showcasing the company's history. The shop sells unusual flavours (e.g., pea and blue cheese) and offers souvenir gifts.

items.label: D
items.title: Horley's
items.text: Preserves 100-year-old recipes, allows visitors to bake cakes and record a custom ad DVD. The factory is in a 17th-century farmhouse with cow tours.

items.label: E
items.title: Carswel's
items.text: Features large gardens, a "Pets' Corner" for children, and a souvenir shop with free ice cream samples. Visitors can try various ice cream flavours.

items.label: F
items.title: Giulio's
items.text: Organises birthday ice-cream cake making, offers tours of the production process, and has beautiful gardens. Families can watch ice cream being made from start to finish.

items.label: G
items.title: Vascmbe's
items.text: Focuses on environmental practices (wind power, recycling), with a lab where new flavours are developed. Housed in a historic cotton factory designed by a 19th-century architect.

items.label: H
items.title: Jacobson's
items.text: Allows visitors to create their own ice cream, produces other dairy products, and has a play area for children. The factory uses sustainable energy and offers recipe cards to take home.

explanations.6: Jing 想参观为生日组织特别活动的工厂，了解冰淇淋制作全过程，父母想在参观时到户外。F 选项 Giulio's 组织生日冰淇淋蛋糕制作，提供生产流程参观，有美丽花园，符合需求。原文 “organises birthday ice-cream cake making, tours of the production process, beautiful gardens” 对应 “birthday special, see production, outdoors”。
explanations.7: Jana 家人想去用传统方法制作冰淇淋的工厂，Jana 想尝试不同活动并带回家东西。B 选项 Henry's 用 50 年传统方法，位于历史农舍，注重环保，游客可会见产奶的奶牛，符合需求。原文 “uses 50-year-old traditional methods, historic farmhouse, meet the cows” 对应 “traditional methods, activities, take home (间接通过体验)”。
explanations.8: Kem 想参观注重环保的工厂，了解新口味发明，爸爸喜欢参观历史建筑。G 选项 Vascmbe's 注重环保实践（风能、回收），有开发新口味的实验室，位于 19 世纪建筑师设计的历史棉纺厂，符合需求。原文 “environmental practices (wind power, recycling), lab for new flavours, historic cotton factory” 对应 “environment, new flavours, historic building”。
explanations.9: Luisa 想自己制作冰淇淋，妈妈想尝试工厂其他产品，给妹妹找娱乐。H 选项 Jacobson's 允许游客制作自己的冰淇淋，生产其他乳制品，有儿童游乐区，符合需求。原文 “create their own ice cream, produces other dairy products, play area for children” 对应 “create ice cream, try other products, entertain sister”。
explanations.10: Matty 想参观生产不寻常口味冰淇淋的工厂并买纪念品，妈妈想了解公司历史。C 选项 Denton's 自 1900 年制作冰淇淋，有展示公司历史的博物馆，商店出售不寻常口味（如豌豆和蓝奶酪）和礼品，符合需求。原文 “museum showcasing the company's history, shop sells unusual flavours, souvenir gifts” 对应 “unusual flavours, souvenir, company history”。
